name: Spinoffy
decision_note: Prague deep-tech spin-off fund (Spinoffy SICAV, managed by AMISTA IS) launched in March 2026 with a EUR 16m target; first announced investment DiagnostiQS (quantum sensors) in October 2026.

evidence.quote: Spinoffy is the first investment fund in Central and Eastern Europe with a built-in, hands-on incubator focused on scientific spin-offs.
Strategy: early-stage deep-tech investments across PoC → Pre-Seed → Seed, with active incubation and structured tech-transfer support.

V Česku ohlásil svůj start nový investiční fond Spinoffy zaměřený na podporu technologických spin-offů už ve fázi ověření konceptu, tedy ve chvíli, kdy se testuje technologie a dřív, než dojde k založení firmy.
Nový fond se zaměřuje na umělou inteligenci a kyberbezpečnost, pokročilou výrobu a robotiku, pokročilé materiály a chemii, kvantové technologie, cleantech a energetiku.
Primárním trhem je Česká republika, fond však pracuje i s projekty ze střední a východní Evropy, pokud mají českou stopu.
Fond do startupu také přímo investoval, konkrétní částku si však chce nechat pro sebe.

Spinoffy 1 is a sub-fund of Spinoffy SICAV a.s., a qualified investors fund established under Czech law and regulated under the Act No. 240/2013 Coll., administered and managed by AMISTA investiční společnost, a.s., a licensed investment company supervised by the Czech National Bank.
V Česku totiž podpořil vznikající projekt DiagnostiQS, zaměřený na kvantové technologie.

analyst_notes: Discovered via CzechCrunch (2026-10-14, DiagnostiQS) and Lupa.cz (2026-03-02 launch). Fund LPs named in the press include Jan Barta (Pale Fire Capital), Martin Vohánka, Václav Dejčmar and Libor Winkler (RSJ), Ondřej Tomek (Impulse Ventures) and Palmont Family Office; these are LPs, not co-investors in the deal, except that Palmont is described as also supporting such projects. Capital: website gives only a target fund size of EUR 16m (CzechCrunch says 'hundreds of millions of CZK'); no close announced, so capital left not_disclosed and the target recorded under funds (undated page). Ticket not disclosed (CzechCrunch: amount in DiagnostiQS 'above standard', undisclosed). DiagnostiQS investment dated by the CzechCrunch article (2026-10-14); round type not stated (PoC/incubation stage). The fund runs its own incubator but is a regulated fund, so the accelerator flag is not set. Legal: Spinoffy SICAV a.s. and sub-fund Spinoffy 1 are managed and administered by AMISTA investiční společnost (licensed AIFM, role other); Spinoffy s.r.o. (statutory body = the three founders per ARES VR) assumed to be the team company.
